mapper.insert: insert into player_withdrawal_cooldown (balance_detail_id, member_id, complaint_id, amount, policy_key, cooldown_hours, created_at, cooldown_until) select #{balanceDetailId}, #{memberId}, #{complaintId}, #{amount}, #{policyKey}, #{cooldownHours}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{cooldownHours} HOUR) from ums_member_balance_detail d where d.id = #{balanceDetailId} and d.member_id = #{memberId} and d.event_type = 9 and d.event_id = #{complaintId} and d.change_type = 1
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from player_withdrawal_cooldown where member_id = #{memberId} and cooldown_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
select * from player_withdrawal_cooldown where member_id = #{memberId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into player_withdrawal_cooldown_config_audit (config_key, before_hours, after_hours, reason, changed_by, changed_at) values ('withdrawal.player-complaint-cooldown-hours', #{beforeHours}, #{afterHours}, #{reason}, #{changedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
